items.title_zh: 下一个十亿美元AI生意可能是“证明你是真人”
items.title_en: The Next Billion-Dollar AI Business Might Be Proving You’re Actually Human
items.summary_zh: 随着AI深度伪造技术日益成熟，区分真实人类与AI生成内容变得愈发困难，验证“你确实是人类”的需求正在催生一个潜在的数十亿美元市场。这类服务可用于身份认证、防止自动化滥用及保护在线社区真实性。文章指出，这类服务的核心在于通过行为分析、生物特征或挑战任务等技术手段，在保护隐私的前提下完成验证。具备可靠、防破解的人机验证能力的初创公司有望成为下一个AI独角兽。不过，如何平衡验证准确性与隐私保护仍是主要挑战。
items.summary_en: The Next Billion-Dollar AI Business Might Be Proving You’re Actually Human Times Square Chronicles
items.why_zh: 人机验证是AI时代信任基础设施的核心，其商业化潜力巨大，将改变数字身份与网络安全格局。
items.why_en: Human-verification AI could become the trust layer of the AI era, with huge commercial potential spanning security and digital identity.

items.title_zh: 可测试人类知识的时间胶囊：单个免费本地模型承载41年Jeopardy!知识
items.title_en: Time Capsule of Testable Human Knowledge: 41 Years of Jeopardy! in a Single Free Local Model
items.summary_zh: 2011年，IBM的Watson系统凭借庞大且精心整理的DeepQA知识库击败了人类Jeopardy!冠军，但这一能力封存在无法移动或复制的服务器集群中。这项研究指出，如今同类的“文化知识快照”已经变得便携且几乎免费：他们用单个9GB的开源模型（Qwen2.5-14B，4-bit量化）在完整的开放Jeopardy!题库上进行评估，并与当年Watson所代表的水平进行比较。研究显示，过去需要超大规模专用基础设施才能实现的知识问答能力，现在可以运行在普通本地设备上。这不仅大幅降低了知识问答AI的门槛，也意味着可以随时携带和测试整个人类知识片段。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In 2011, IBM's Watson was something like a sealed capsule of its era's queryable knowledge. Its DeepQA system defeated the strongest human Jeopardy! champions, but the knowledge that let it do so lived in a curated billion-document corpus running on a cluster of POWER7 servers, frozen at build time and impossible to move or copy. We show that the same kind of artifact, a snapshot of what a culture can answer, is now portable and essentially free. We evaluate a single 9 GB open-weight model (Qwen2.5-14B, 4-bit) against the complete open Jeopardy!…
items.why_zh: 这代表着可测试知识从专用大型系统转向免费本地模型，让知识问答能力触手可及。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a shift from specialized massive systems to free local models, making question-answering knowledge accessible to all.

items.title_zh: 给评委打分：用Rasch测量理论改进LLM评估
items.title_en: Rating the Raters: Rasch Measurement Theory for LLM Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型现已同时扮演多种角色：作为基准测试的考生、评判其他模型输出的裁判，以及为人类内容打分的评分者。论文指出，这些范式本质上都是测量问题，需要从测量理论的角度进行分析。作者认为，当前的评估实践往往忽略每个核心组件（如模型能力、题目难度、评分者倾向）对最终结果的独立贡献，从而限制了对“被测量内容”的理解。他们提出采用Rasch测量理论（RMT）来分解这种贡献，该方法已经广泛应用于教育测量等领域。通过RMT，可以更精细地评估LLM的能力和偏差，为下一代AI评估体系提供理论基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27463v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs now sit on every side of evaluation: as examinees scored on benchmarks, judges of other models' outputs, and raters of human-generated content. Each paradigm can be viewed as a measurement problem, where a latent property of an object is probed with items from an instrument (e.g., benchmark) by raters. Standard evaluation practices often neglect the contributions of each core component to the end result, limiting our understanding of what is being measured. Rasch measurement theory (RMT) is well-suited to this kind of problem. RMT decomposes…
items.why_zh: 该研究为理解并规范LLM评估提供了成熟的测量学工具，有助于建立更科学、可信的AI能力评价体系。
items.why_en: It brings a well-established measurement framework to LLM evaluation, making AI capability assessment more scientific and trustworthy.

items.title_zh: LLM增强的因果发现：边存在性与方向的概率融合
items.title_en: LLM-Augmented Causal Discovery: Probabilistic Fusion of Edge Existence and Orientation
items.summary_zh: 从观测数据中学习贝叶斯网络结构时，一个老大难问题是因果边的方向往往无法识别；而大语言模型虽然拥有广泛的因果知识，但可靠性参差不齐。研究者提出将这两类互补信息源融合起来，新表示称为概率依赖图（PDG）：每条边对应一个概率分布，表示该边可能是有向、无向或不存在，并通过加权平均的方式整合数据和LLM的判断。他们在26个基准网络上进行了评估，将三个贝叶斯网络结构学习系综与LLM信息结合。结果显示，这种概率融合能更好地区分边的存在性和方向，为因果发现提供了一种更稳健的方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian network structure learning (BNSL) from observational data struggles with orientation identifiability, while large language models (LLMs) offer broad but often unreliable causal knowledge. We propose combining these complementary sources through a novel representation, termed Probabilistic Dependency Graphs (PDGs). In a PDG, each edge is associated with a distribution over directed, undirected, and absent states, enabling fusion via weighted averaging. We evaluate this approach on 26 benchmark networks, combining ensembles of three BNSL a…
items.why_zh: 该方法把不可靠但广泛的LLM先验知识与统计学习系统结合，显著增强了因果结构学习的鲁棒性。
items.why_en: This method robustly combines broad LLM priors with statistical learning, strengthening causal structure discovery.

items.title_zh: 在真实挑战场景中评估通用移动助手：GMA基准
items.title_en: Benchmarking General Mobile Assistants in Challenging Real-World Scenarios
items.summary_zh: 图形用户界面已成为测试自主AI代理多模态交互能力的重要环境，但现有基准如AndroidWorld和MobileWorld在应用覆盖范围与任务设计上，还不足以反映现实移动使用的多样性。为此，研究者推出了GMA基准，专门面向通用移动助手在挑战性真实场景中的表现。GMA引入了七个基于开源项目构建的应用程序，覆盖更多维度的任务类型和交互复杂度。该基准有望更严格地评测移动代理在真实世界的可用性，推动通用移动助手从实验室走向日常应用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphical user interfaces have emerged as an important environment for evaluating autonomous AI agents on multimodal interactive tasks. Existing benchmarks such as AndroidWorld and MobileWorld provide strong foundations for mobile agent evaluation, but their application coverage and task design do not yet fully capture the diversity and complexity of realistic mobile use. We present GMA, a benchmark for evaluating general mobile assistants in challenging real-world scenarios. GMA introduces seven applications based on open-source projects, spanni…
items.why_zh: GMA填补了移动代理评估在真实复杂度和应用多样性上的空缺，为通用移动助手提供了更严苛的测试场。
items.why_en: GMA fills the gap in mobile agent evaluation for real-world complexity and diversity, offering a stricter testbed.

items.title_zh: 物联网与深度学习用于茶园白蚁检测及严重程度评估的有效性
items.title_en: Effectiveness of IoT and Deep Learning for Detection and Severity Assessment of Postelectrotermes militaris in Tea Plantations
items.summary_zh: 内陆活木白蚁（ULWT）是茶园的重要害虫，一旦虫害未被及时察觉，会造成严重经济损失。本研究提出一种物联网声学监测框架，并融合深度学习进行白蚁侵害的早期检测和严重程度评估。具体方法上，研究者使用连接树莓派的高灵敏度麦克风，非侵入式地从茶树干采集音频信号，同时记录地理坐标等环境信息。该系统能够自动识别白蚁活动的声学特征，便于茶园管理者及时干预。这项技术为农业害虫监测提供了一种自动化、低成本的思路，有助于减少对人工巡查的依赖。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tea plantations are vulnerable to Postelectrotermes militaris, commonly known as the Upcountry Live Wood Termite (ULWT), which can cause substantial damage when infestations remain undetected. This study proposes an IoT-enabled acoustic monitoring framework integrated with deep learning for early detection and severity assessment of ULWT infestations in tea plantations. Research Method: Audio signals were captured non-invasively from tea trunks using a high-sensitivity microphone connected to a Raspberry Pi-based IoT device, with geographic coord…
items.why_zh: 该研究将物联网与深度学习结合，为茶园白蚁防治提供非侵入式、可扩展的自动监测方案，有助减少经济损失。
items.why_en: It combines IoT sensing with deep learning for non-invasive, scalable termite monitoring in tea plantations, reducing economic losses.

items.title_zh: 基于知识的系统中广义水平评估的上下文定位
items.title_en: Context Localization for Generalized Level-Based Evaluation in Knowledge-Based Systems
items.summary_zh: 在知识密集型AI系统中，评估通常不是孤立进行的，而是在不同的知识上下文下，对事实、规则、案例或证据单元等赋予的非负分数进行条件聚合测试。论文提出了一个广义水平评估框架：在满足规定聚合支持度的所有上下文中，最大化一个单调集合函数，从而得到系统的“水平”度量。作者进一步分析了“上下文定位”问题，即何时按上下文B过滤分数可以等价于将评估限制在某个局部上下文中。他们给出了刻画这一等价性的条件，使评估过程更具可解释性和灵活性。该工作为复杂知识库中的分层评估提供了形式化工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study context localization for generalized level-based evaluation in knowledge-based systems. The framework models situations where a structured nonnegative score, defined on facts, rules, cases, criteria or evidence units, is evaluated through conditional aggregation tests on admissible knowledge contexts. The generalized level measure maximizes a monotone set function over all contexts whose aggregated support reaches a prescribed level. We characterize when filtering the score by a context $B$ is equivalent to localizing the admissible cont…
items.why_zh: 该形式化框架能帮助在知识密集型系统中精确限定评估范围，提升评估的透明度和计算效率。
items.why_en: This formal framework enables precise scoping of evaluation in knowledge-rich systems, improving transparency and efficiency.

items.title_zh: 如果代理是天使，就无需治理：在可信工具边界实施带外策略
items.title_en: If Agents Were Angels, No Governance Would Be Necessary: Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement at a Trusted Tool Boundary
items.summary_zh: 当AI代理获得人类的凭证后，它将继承人的权限范围，却未必有同样可靠的判断力：它可能把所有可达记录搜刮进上下文，受隐藏指令操控，并在超出任务授权或窃取秘密时仍保持凭证有效。仅靠提示词作为护栏并不可靠，因为负责解释任务并执行约束的推理器本身就可能出错。论文提出带外策略执行（OBPE），把策略检查放到代理推理之外的可信边界上，对操作类型与资源进行授权。即使代理因提示注入或自身失误而偏离任务，OBPE也能阻止未授权的行为，为代理治理提供了硬性技术保障。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Give an agent a human's credential and it inherits the person's reach without the judgment that limits its use. It can sweep every reachable record into model context, where hidden instructions steer its next call, and every request stays credential-valid while the agent exceeds its job or absorbs a secret. Prompts are a brittle guardrail: one fallible reasoner interprets the task and enforces its limits. We present Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement (OBPE), a trusted boundary outside agent reasoning. It authorizes the typed operation and resource, n…
items.why_zh: 该机制在代理推理之外建立硬性安全边界，为解决AI代理权限滥用问题提供了不依赖模型判断的可行方案。
items.why_en: It establishes a trusted boundary outside agent reasoning, offering a model-independent solution to AI agent permission abuse.

items.title_zh: 通过吉布斯采样与可解释生成控制探测多模态大模型的感知先验
items.title_en: Probing Perceptual Priors of MLLMs via Gibbs Sampling with Interpretable Generative Controls
items.summary_zh: 模型在任务上的表现由输入和其内在先验共同决定，而先验是模型对刺激的隐含期望分布。传统可解释性研究要么固定输入来检查内部结构（机械性），要么研究输入变化如何影响输出（行为性），却无法直接重建先验本身。这篇文章提出一种新的探测方法：利用吉布斯采样，并配合可解释的生成控制，从多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的生成行为中逆向推断它期望的刺激分布。通过这种方式，研究者可以直接观察模型的感知偏好和先验假设。该方法有望揭示MLLM在视觉-语言任务中的系统性偏见，并为幻觉等问题的诊断提供线索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A model's behavior on a task is jointly determined by the input it receives and the prior it brings in, i.e. the distribution over stimuli it implicitly expects. Interpretability research has traditionally studied models by holding inputs fixed and examining model responses either mechanistically, probing how internal structure represents inputs, or behaviorally, measuring how variation in inputs leads to variation in outputs. Neither reconstructs the prior distribution itself, since internal structure shows what a model can represent, not what i…
items.why_zh: 该研究首次让先验本身可被直接观测，为解释和纠正多模态大模型的感知偏见提供了新手段。
items.why_en: This work makes the prior itself observable, offering new tools to explain and correct perceptual biases in multimodal LLMs.

items.title_zh: 资源约束与智能体AI系统性能研究
items.title_en: Resource Constraints and Performance in Agentic AI Systems
items.summary_zh: 本文研究资源约束对智能体AI系统性能的影响。作者比较了OpenClaw和NanoBot两个完整的智能体系统，采用配对主要基准测试和更详细的仪器化提示子集。结果表明，在主要基准测试中，OpenClaw的完整任务完成率为31%，NanoBot为25%，相差6个百分点。研究还分析了工具、记忆、状态管理和多步执行等机制如何影响任务能力与运行负担，为设计高效自主AI系统提供了依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27886v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Progress toward more autonomous AI increasingly depends on agentic systems that combine a language model with tools, memory, state management, and multi-step execution. These mechanisms shape both task capability and operational burden. We compare OpenClaw and NanoBot as complete agentic systems using a paired primary benchmark and a more detailed instrumented subset of paired prompts. In the primary benchmark, the rate of full task completion was 31% for OpenClaw and 25% for NanoBot, a six-percentage-point difference with a 95% task-bootstrap in…
items.why_zh: 为资源受限条件下智能体系统的性能评估与优化提供了实证比较。
items.why_en: Provides empirical comparison of agentic systems under resource constraints, informing design trade-offs.

items.title_zh: 面向强化学习的评分标准到代码信用分配方法
items.title_en: Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 交互式Web应用生成要求模型根据自然语言请求生成可用的HTML、CSS和JavaScript代码。与常规代码生成不同，应用质量取决于多个面向用户的功能需求，每个需求通常对应局部代码片段（如事件处理、状态更新、DOM片段或CSS选择器）。标准的GRPO方法将这些结构化结果压缩为单一的序列级奖励，并对所有令牌统一分配优势，从而削弱了信用分配。本文提出了一种新的方法，将评分标准映射到具体的代码区域，以加强强化学习中的信用分配，有望提升Web应用生成的准确性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactive web application generation requires models to produce usable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript applications from natural language requests. Unlike conventional code generation, application quality depends on multiple user-facing functional requirements, each often tied to localized code regions such as event handlers, state updates, DOM fragments, or CSS selectors. Standard GRPO collapses these structured outcomes into a single sequence-level reward and applies the resulting advantage uniformly to all tokens, weakening credit assignment. We p…
items.why_zh: 解决了强化学习在代码生成中信用分配粗粒度的问题，有助于提升复杂Web应用生成质量。
items.why_en: Addresses coarse-grained credit assignment in RL for code generation, improving quality of complex web apps.

items.title_zh: 从文档到推理：用于金融数值推理的验证合成数据管道与语义感知微调
items.title_en: From Documents to Reasoning: A Validated Synthetic Data Pipeline and Semantic-Aware Fine-Tuning for Financial Numerical Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 金融问答已成为评估大语言模型在表格、图表和丰富文本等复杂数据上领域任务表现的关键基准。尽管近期模型已能跨模态推理并进行多步算术运算，但性能一致性和评估可靠性仍存在不足。标准指标（如精确匹配）往往忽略了数字格式等细微差异。为此，本文提出一种经过验证的合成数据管道和语义感知微调方法，旨在提升LLM在金融数值推理任务中的准确性与评估鲁棒性，为金融领域AI应用提供了更可靠的训练与评估方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Financial question answering (QA) has emerged as a key benchmark for evaluating the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on domain-specific tasks involving complex data formats such as tables, charts, and rich textual narratives. While recent advancements have enabled models to reason across modalities and perform multi-step arithmetic operations, limitations remain in performance consistency, and evaluation reliability. In particular, standard evaluation metrics like Exact Match (EM) often fail to account for minor variations such as diff…
items.why_zh: 为金融数值推理提供了更稳健的训练数据生成与评估方法，降低评估误导风险。
items.why_en: Offers a robust synthetic data and evaluation approach for financial numerical reasoning, mitigating misleading metrics.

items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的堆叠集成框架预测涡扇发动机剩余寿命
items.title_en: A Deep Learning-Based Stacking Ensemble Framework for Turbofan Engine Remaining Useful Life Prediction
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出了一种用于涡扇发动机剩余寿命预测的两级堆叠集成框架，并在NASA C-MAPSS基准的FD001和FD003子集上进行了评估。框架整合了四种异质深度学习基学习器——长短期记忆网络（LSTM）、卷积神经网络（CNN）、CNN-LSTM和CNN-GRU，并通过XGBoost元学习器组合它们的袋外预测，从而捕捉复杂退化模式并减少个体模型偏差。综合实验证明了该框架在预测性能和鲁棒性方面的优势，为设备健康管理提供了有效工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study proposes a two-level stacking ensemble framework for Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction of turbofan engines, evaluated on the NASA C-MAPSS benchmark using the FD001 and FD003 subsets. The framework integrates four heterogeneous deep learning base learners: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), CNN-LSTM, and CNN-GRU, whose out-of-fold predictions are combined by an XGBoost meta-learner to capture complex degradation patterns while mitigating individual model biases. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate…
items.why_zh: 提供了一种高精度、稳健的剩余寿命预测方法，对工业设备维护决策具有实用价值。
items.why_en: Offers a highly accurate and robust RUL prediction method valuable for industrial maintenance decisions.

items.title_zh: 跨会话分解攻击：缩放风险与意图对齐检索防御
items.title_en: Cross-Session Decomposition Attacks: Scaling Risk and Intent-Aligned Retrieval Defense
items.summary_zh: 缩放定律通常被视为模型能力提升的故事，但其安全后果值得关注。本文研究了跨会话分解攻击：攻击者将恶意目标拆分为看似良性的子查询，放在独立对话中询问，再重组实现被禁止的目标。作者将该场景形式化为“组合安全风险”，并证明了条件风险转移界限：当参考环境已包含分散的恶意重组证据时，部署与参考环境的风险差距将受该界限约束。对此，文章提出一种意图对齐的检索防御机制，通过检索与用户真实意图对齐的信息，降低此类攻击的成功率。这项研究揭示了缩放对安全的影响，并为多会话交互下的模型防护提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27945v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling laws are usually read as a capability story: lower language-modeling loss yields more useful models. We study a safety consequence of this mechanism in \emph{cross-session decomposition attacks}, where benign-looking subqueries are asked across independent interactions and later recomposed toward a forbidden objective. We formalize this setting as \emph{compositional safety risk} and prove a conditional risk-transfer bound: when the reference environment already contains dispersed evidence for a risky reconstruction, the gap between deplo…
items.why_zh: 揭示了AI缩放带来的组合安全风险，并提出针对性防御，对多轮交互安全具有重要启示。
items.why_en: Highlights compositional safety risks from scaling and proposes a defense, informing secure multi-session AI interactions.

items.title_zh: “如果”的幻觉：评估大语言模型反事实推理的失效
items.title_en: The Illusion of $\textit{What If}$: Evaluating the Breakdown of Counterfactual Reasoning in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 反事实推理要求模型超越观察到的世界，解释改变的条件如何传导至下游后果。现有基准多局限于固定变量或单一标准答案的受限环境，忽略了需要因果过程评估的开放领域场景。为此，本文提出WhatIfBench，一个面向开放域、开放形式、长程反事实因果推理的诊断基准，包含STEM、人文社科及混合场景中的220个what-if问题。该基准用于系统评估大语言模型在反事实推理中的表现，揭示其在复杂因果推理中的失效模式，为改进模型推理能力提供了新测试平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Counterfactual reasoning requires models to reason beyond the observed world and explain how altered conditions propagate through downstream consequences. Existing benchmarks largely target bounded settings with fixed variables or single gold outcomes, overlooking open-domain scenarios requiring causal-process evaluation. To this end, we present $\textbf{WhatIfBench}$, a diagnostic benchmark for open-domain, open-form, long-horizon counterfactual causal reasoning, containing 220 what-if questions across STEM, HSS, and Hybrid scenarios. To evaluat…
items.why_zh: 提供了首个覆盖开放域长程反事实推理的基准，填补了现有评估空白。
items.why_en: Provides a new benchmark for open-domain long-horizon counterfactual reasoning, filling a gap in LLM evaluation.

items.title_zh: GOD：治理、观察与引导——智能体社会的实时控制室
items.title_en: GOD: Govern, Observe, and Direct - A Real-Time Control Room for Agent Societies
items.summary_zh: 生成式智能体系统启动容易但检查困难。一次运行可能包含大量智能体、位置、消息、命令和模型调用，而操作员通常只能看到最终回放或原始日志，难以理解智能体的行为动机、测试干预措施或向其他研究者分享运行状态。为此，本文提出GOD系统，一个本地优先的智能体社会实时控制室。通过统一的浏览器工作流，操作员可以提出针对性问题、执行干预并检查回放状态。系统整合了设置向导等组件，旨在提升智能体系统的可观察性和可控性，帮助研究者更高效地调试和理解复杂的智能体交互。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative-agent systems are easier to start than to inspect. A run can contain many agents, locations, messages, commands, and model calls, yet the operator often gets either a finished replay or raw logs. That makes it hard to ask why an agent moved, test a small intervention, or package a run for another researcher. GOD is a local-first control room for agent societies. From the same browser workflow, an operator can issue targeted questions or interventions and inspect the resulting replay state. The system combines a setup wizard, Agent Stud…
items.why_zh: 为多智能体系统提供了实时监控与干预工具，填补了可观察性空白。
items.why_en: Offers real-time monitoring and intervention for multi-agent systems, addressing a key observability gap.

items.title_zh: 该用这份合成数据训练吗？如何用最少真实数据测试
items.title_en: Should I Use This Synthetic Dataset for Training? How to Test with Minimal Real Data
items.summary_zh: 在工程系统中，数字孪生和学习世界模型常被用来生成合成数据，以扩充稀缺的真实训练数据。然而，由于模拟与真实的固有差距，合成数据增强未必能提升模型在真实数据分布上的表现。本文针对这一问题提出了一个决策框架：给定真实数据集、候选合成数据集和固定的学习算法，在仅使用少量真实数据的条件下，判断使用该合成数据集进行训练是否值得。该方法帮助从业者在资源有限时做出更明智的数据选择，避免因不匹配的合成数据而损害模型性能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Digital twins (DTs) and learned world models are increasingly used to generate synthetic data that augment the scarce real datasets available for training artificial intelligence (AI) models in engineering systems. Owing to the inevitable simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) gap, however, augmentation may fail to improve the performance of the trained model on the real data distribution. This paper addresses the resulting decision problem: Given a real dataset, a candidate synthetic dataset, and a fixed learning algorithm, decide whether training…
items.why_zh: 为工程应用中合成数据的使用提供了低成本的可行性检验方法，避免无效训练。
items.why_en: Provides a low-cost test for using synthetic data in training, preventing ineffective augmentation.

items.title_zh: 基于多智能体大语言模型的多语言气候-健康文献自动分析框架
items.title_en: Automated Analysis Framework for Multilingual Climate-Health Literature Based on Multi-Agent Large Language Model
items.summary_zh: 跨学科和多语言科学文献快速增长，传统人工分析和单一算法方法效率低、可扩展性差、领域适应性不足。针对气候-健康这一典型跨学科领域的文献分析需求，该研究提出了一个基于多智能体大语言模型的自动分析框架，用于多语言科学文献，实现了涵盖文献筛选、结构化信息提取等全流程自动化。该框架有望提升文献综述的效率与可扩展性，适应跨学科领域的需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid proliferation of interdisciplinary and multilingual scientific literature has left traditional manual analysis and single-algorithm methods plagued by low efficiency, poor scalability, and insufficient domain adaptability. Targeting the literature analysis needs of the typical interdisciplinary climate-health field, this study proposes a multi-agent large language model automated analysis framework for multilingual scientific literature, which realizes full-process automation covering literature screening, structured information extract…
items.why_zh: 该框架展示了多智能体大模型在跨学科文献自动分析中的应用潜力，可大幅提升综述效率与可扩展性。
items.why_en: This framework demonstrates the potential of multi-agent LLMs for automated cross-disciplinary literature analysis, improving efficiency and scalability.

items.title_zh: String：将每个应用视为 Markdown 文件的智能体操作系统
items.title_en: String: An Agentic OS Where Every App Is a Markdown File
items.summary_zh: LLM 智能体已成为新的软件用户类别，但它们使用的每个界面都是为他人设计的。网页面向人类眼睛，工具模式面向程序。智能体需要重新阅读并为其看到的每一项内容付费。为此，作者提出了 String，一个开源运行时，为智能体提供自己的界面，并将任务视为操作系统问题。通过将工具知识移出智能体的上下文，String 有望显著降低智能体的使用成本和复杂性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents have become a new class of software user, but every surface they work through was designed for someone else. Pages are built for human eyes, which can skim and ignore; tool schemas for programs, which pay nothing to carry definitions they never call. An agent has neither luxury: it re-reads, and pays again for, everything it is shown on every turn. We present String, an open-source runtime that gives this user an interface of its own and treats the job as an operating-systems problem. Tool knowledge moves out of the agent's context and…
items.why_zh: 它重新思考了智能体与软件交互的底层方式，可能成为智能体操作系统设计的重要方向。
items.why_en: It rethinks the fundamental interaction between agents and software, potentially shaping the design of agent-centric operating systems.

items.title_zh: 生成式 AI 与印度教神学多元性及神圣表征的对齐
items.title_en: Generative AI Alignment with Hinduism's Theological Plurality and Sacred Representation
items.summary_zh: 生成式 AI 越来越多地用于回答个人问题和介入日常实践，包括宗教领域。然而，现有关于 AI 对齐和伦理的讨论主要基于世俗、西方和亚伯拉罕宗教的假设，对其他信仰传统关注有限。该论文考察了印度教用户如何在宗教知识、信仰和实践中使用生成式 AI。基于对 15 位孟加拉国印度教参与者的半结构化访谈，研究分析了他们与这些系统的互动过程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28228v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly used to answer personal questions and mediate everyday practices, including religion. However, existing discussions around AI alignment and ethics have largely centered secular, Western, and Abrahamic assumptions about religion, offering limited attention to other faith-based traditions. In this paper, we examine how Hindu users engage with generative AI systems in relation to their religious knowledge, belief, and practice. Drawing on 15 semi-structured interviews with Bangladeshi Hindu participants, we ana…
items.why_zh: 该研究填补了 AI 对齐研究中非西方宗教视角的空白，有助于构建更具文化包容性的 AI 系统。
items.why_en: This work fills a gap in AI alignment research by incorporating non-Western religious perspectives, promoting more culturally inclusive AI systems.

items.title_zh: REINS：基于稀疏自编码器特征的拒绝增强抑制性引导
items.title_en: REINS: Refusal-Enhanced Inhibitory Steering with Sparse Autoencoder Features
items.summary_zh: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行引导提供了一种轻量级的推理时路径，无需重新训练即可调整大语言模型的行为。通过暴露稀疏且可解释的特征，SAE 引导为安全控制提供了有前景的界面，可将有害延续引导至拒绝方向。然而，研究者观察到，复杂的封装仍可能破坏现有 SAE 引导方法在有害提示上的效果。为了系统评估这种失败模式，他们构建了广义地下指令安全评估（GUISE）数据集。该工作旨在提升 LLM 在复杂攻击下的安全性能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Steering with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offers a lightweight inference-time path for adapting the behavior of large language models without retraining. By exposing sparse and interpretable features, SAE steering provides a promising interface for safety control that guides harmful continuations toward refusal. However, we observe that complex wrappers can still undermine existing SAE steering methods on harmful prompts. To evaluate this failure mode systematically, we construct Generalized Undercover Instruction Safety Evaluation (GUISE), a data…
items.why_zh: 它揭示并评估了现有一类安全引导方法的漏洞，为提升大模型抵御复杂提示攻击的能力提供了新基准。
items.why_en: It reveals vulnerabilities in SAE-based safety steering and provides a new benchmark for evaluating LLM robustness against complex harmful prompts.

items.title_zh: 物理引导的流匹配用于 CT 图像重建
items.title_en: Physics-Guided Flow Matching for CT Image Reconstruction
items.summary_zh: 深度生成模型已成为解决 CT 中不适定逆问题的强大先验，基于扩散的方法达到了最先进的重建性能。然而，扩散模型通常依赖随机采样过程、较长的推理轨迹和精心调优的噪声计划，这可能限制计算效率和数值稳定性，尤其在高空间分辨率下。该工作研究将流匹配（Flow Matching）作为 CT 重建的替代生成先验，旨在提供更高效、更稳定的重建方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep generative models have recently emerged as powerful priors for solving ill-posed inverse problems in CT, with diffusion-based approaches achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction performance. However, diffusion models typically rely on stochastic sampling procedures, long inference trajectories, and carefully tuned noise schedules, which can limit computational efficiency and numerical stability, especially at high spatial resolutions. In this work, we investigate Flow Matching as an alternative generative prior for CT reconstruction. We tra…
items.why_zh: 它为 CT 图像重建提供了一种可能更高效、更稳定的生成式方案，有望替代计算成本较高的扩散模型。
items.why_en: It offers a potentially more efficient and stable generative approach for CT reconstruction, serving as an alternative to diffusion models.

items.title_zh: RECAST：流式生物信号测试时自适应的近期与上下文感知采样
items.title_en: RECAST: Recent & Context-Aware Sampling for Test-Time Adaptation in Streaming Biosignals
items.summary_zh: 流式生物信号在不同受试者之间变化并随时间漂移，因此群体训练模型在长期监测中会失去准确性。测试时自适应（TTA）通过更新模型以适应新样本，实现在线个性化。但在流式环境中，一个基本问题仍未解决：每次更新应该由哪些样本驱动？使用所有缓冲样本会用无关片段模糊更新；仅使用最新片段则使更新嘈杂且不稳定。最有用的样本应是近期的、与当前生理状态对齐的。该工作提出了 RECAST 方法，以近期和上下文感知的方式选择样本，驱动 TTA 更新。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Streaming biosignals vary across subjects and drift over time, so population-trained models lose accuracy during long-term monitoring. Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables online personalization by updating the model on incoming samples. But in a stream, a basic question is left open: \emph{which samples should drive each update?} Using all buffered samples blurs the update with irrelevant segments. Using only the latest segment makes the update noisy and unstable. The most useful samples are recent, aligned with the current physiological state, an…
items.why_zh: 它为长期生物信号监测中的模型个性化提供了更优的样本选择策略，有望提升可穿戴健康监测的准确性。
items.why_en: It improves sample selection for test-time adaptation in streaming biosignals, potentially enhancing long-term wearable health monitoring.

items.title_zh: LoopArena：将模型作为循环工程运行时控制器的基准测试
items.title_en: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
items.summary_zh: 循环工程正在成为一种围绕编码智能体组织开发工作的实践。实践者不是手工编写每条提示，而是设计循环来监控进度、分配工作、运行检查并决定智能体下一步该做什么。即使拥有强大的编码智能体，循环也可能信任过时的进度说明、跳过必要的验证、将预算花在错误的方向，或在任务安全提交前停止。然而，一次端到端运行的结果无法判断成功或失败反映的是循环的指导还是编码智能体本身的性能。LoopArena 旨在提供一种基准测试方法，评估模型作为运行时控制器的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whether success or failure reflects the loop's guidance or…
items.why_zh: 它为新兴的“循环工程”开发实践提供了首个评估手段，有助于理解如何塑造编码智能体的工作流程。
items.why_en: It provides an evaluation framework for the emerging practice of loop engineering, helping shape the workflow of coding agents.

items.title_zh: GRACE：用于大语言模型遗忘的梯度引导核心集选择
items.title_en: GRACE:Gradient-guided Coreset Selection for LLM Unlearning
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型的机器遗忘方法通常假设预先指定遗忘集和保留集。然而，在现实场景中，请求可能只提供少数不需要的行为示例，需要从异构语料库中推断遗忘集和保留集。该研究研究了这个数据选择问题，并提出 GRACE，一种梯度引导的核心集选择方法，为大模型遗忘构建遗忘集和保留集。GRACE 首先从引发不需要行为的种子示例中计算遗忘方向，然后选择核心样本集。该方法旨在更实际地实现 LLM 遗忘，减少对大量预定义数据的需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine Unlearning methods for Large Language Models typically assume pre-specified forget and retain sets. In realistic settings, however, requests may provide only a few examples of undesired behavior, requiring forget and retain sets to be inferred from heterogeneous corpora. We study this data-selection problem and propose GRACE , a gradient-guided coreset selection method that constructs both forget and retain sets for LLM unlearning. GRACE first computes a forget direction from seed examples that elicit the undesired behavior, then selects…
items.why_zh: 它解决了大模型遗忘中训练数据选择的现实难题，让遗忘操作在只有少量示例时也能可靠进行。
items.why_en: It addresses the practical data selection challenge in LLM unlearning, enabling reliable forgetting with only a few example requests.

items.title_zh: MAP：面向真实世界地点多模态可访问性规划的基准
items.title_en: MAP: A Benchmark on Multimodal Accessibility Planning for Real World Places
items.summary_zh: MAP是首个用于评估多模态AI系统帮助有可访问性需求的用户规划实地访问的基准。在评估中，系统需要根据用户请求验证或推荐符合特定可访问性要求的地点。该基准包含两项新颖的评估任务：可访问性规划的声称验证，用于核实地点信息及其所述可访问性特征是否得到支持，并找出满足要求的地点；以及视觉相关评估任务。这一基准旨在推动多模态AI在真实世界无障碍场景中的应用与评测，为开发更可靠的辅助技术提供了标准化的测试平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce MAP, the first benchmark to evaluate multimodal AI systems as assistants for users with accessibility requirements when planning visits to places in the real world. In our evaluation, systems are presented with requests to verify or recommend a point of interest meeting an accessibility requirement. MAP contains two novel assessments: Claim verification for accessibility planning assesses if information on places and stated accessibility features is supported and identifies places that satisfy requested accessibility features. Visual…
items.why_zh: 首个面向真实世界地点可访问性规划的多模态AI基准，填补了无障碍场景评测空白。
items.why_en: It is the first benchmark for multimodal AI in real-world accessibility planning, filling a gap in evaluating assistive systems for users with accessibility needs.

items.title_zh: 面向大规模电商的时机感知复购预测：多界面杂货推荐的生存模型
items.title_en: Timing-Aware Repurchase Prediction for Web-Scale E-Commerce: Survival Models for Multi-Surface Grocery Recommendation
items.summary_zh: 电商中的复购推荐通常被视为二分类问题，即“客户是否会在W天内购买该商品”，这需要为每个预测时间窗口单独训练模型。本文提出用生存模型取代这一流程，直接预测复购时间，并在某大型杂货电商平台的数百万用户上进行了三十多种消融配置评估。研究发现，经验风险分析显示边际递减的特征，并给出了三项贡献。该方法避免了为多个时间窗口重复训练，提升了推荐系统的效率和可扩展性，对多界面杂货推荐尤其有价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28393v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Repurchase recommenders in e-commerce are commonly framed as a binary question asking "will this customer buy this item within W days", a formulation that requires a separately trained model for every horizon of interest. We replace this stack with survival models that predict time-to-repurchase directly, and evaluate them on millions of customers from a major grocery e-commerce platform across more than thirty ablation configurations. Our study makes three contributions. First, an empirical hazard analysis reveals a slightly decreasing marginal…
items.why_zh: 提出用生存模型直接预测复购时间，避免为每个时间窗口单独训练，对大规模电商推荐意义重大。
items.why_en: It replaces horizon-specific binary models with survival models to directly predict repurchase time, improving efficiency and scalability for web-scale e-commerce.

items.title_zh: RetailAgent：自条件多模态LLM交易代理中的结构化不利时机
items.title_en: RetailAgent: Structured Adverse Timing in Self-Conditioned Multimodal LLM Trading Agents
items.summary_zh: 金融市场中，对价格变动做出系统性反应的顺序策略可能被其他市场参与者预判。本文提出RetailAgent实验框架，研究大语言模型代理是否表现出这种方向性结构。在该框架中，LLM观察匿名的日内股票价格历史和允许的状态，然后在下一区间回报公布前反复选择做多或保持空仓。通过比较做多和空仓期间的回报，文章检验LLM交易策略的可预测性及其可能的“不利时机”。这项工作有助于理解LLM在真实交易场景中的行为模式及其对市场的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In financial markets, a sequential policy that reacts systematically to price movements may become predictable to other market participants. This paper studies whether large language model (LLM) agents exhibit such directional structure through RetailAgent, an experimental framework in which an LLM observes anonymized intraday equity price histories and permitted state, then repeatedly chooses long (hold the stock) or flat (stay out) before the subsequent interval return is revealed. We compare returns during long and flat intervals along the sam…
items.why_zh: 首次系统研究LLM交易策略是否因系统化反应而变得可预测，对算法交易安全有启示。
items.why_en: It investigates whether LLM trading agents become predictable due to systematic reactions, with implications for market safety and AI trading.

items.title_zh: VERA-8B：基于证据的SEC文件审计风险推理
items.title_en: VERA-8B: Evidence-Grounded Audit Risk Reasoning from SEC Filings
items.summary_zh: 审计工作必须依靠合理证据，但标准金融语言模型更注重回答的流畅性而非证据支撑，可能生成看似合理却含糊的答案，存在证据支撑不足的差距，不适合审计场景。为此，研究者提出VERA-8B，一个全新的端到端审计推理系统，旨在执法行动发生前识别审计风险。构建该模型面临诸多挑战，因为此前没有针对审计证据推理的机器学习工作。VERA-8B专注于基于SEC文件证据的审计风险判断，有望提升金融审计的可靠性和前瞻性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Across audit applications, judgments must be supported by reasonable evidence. However, standard financial language models prioritize fluency over evidence. They are built for general financial reasoning and may produce plausible but ambiguous answers, creating a grounding gap that makes them unsuitable for audit work. We address this gap with VERA-8B, a new end-to-end audit reasoning system that identifies audit risks before enforcement actions occur. Constructing such a model raises several challenges, as no prior machine learning work targets…
items.why_zh: 首个面向审计证据推理的端到端系统，填补了金融语言模型在审计领域证据支撑不足的空白。
items.why_en: It is the first end-to-end audit reasoning system grounded in evidence, bridging the grounding gap that made standard financial language models unsuitable for audit work.

items.title_zh: 可验证奖励的程序学习：用于LLM后训练的符号反向传播
items.title_en: Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards: Symbolic Backpropagation for Post-Training LLMs
items.summary_zh: 传统上，训练语言模型进行推理意味着更新其权重，无论是监督微调还是强化学习，都将能力嵌入模型内部，导致无法逐步检查、验证或迁移至其他模型。本文提出一种观点：对于中间步骤可以验证的任务，应将推理能力放到基础模型权重之外，以由确定性和神经原语组成的显式程序形式存在。为此，作者引入了PLVR（可验证奖励的程序学习）后训练方法，利用符号反向传播来学习这种程序。该方法有望提升推理过程的透明度和可迁移性，为可验证推理任务提供了新的后训练范式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post training a language model to reason means updating its weights. Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning both place the acquired capability inside the model where it cannot be inspected cannot be checked step by step and cannot be moved to another model. We argue that for tasks whose intermediate steps admit verification, reasoning is better placed outside the base models weights as an explicit program composed from deterministic and neural primitives. We introduce PLVR (Program Learning with Verifiable Rewards): a post training meth…
items.why_zh: 提出将可验证推理从模型权重中分离为显式程序，让推理过程可检查、可验证、可迁移。
items.why_en: It proposes moving verifiable reasoning outside LLM weights as explicit programs, enabling inspection, verification, and transferability.

items.title_zh: 学习使用工具：面向工具集成数学推理的强化学习
items.title_en: Learning to Use Tools: Reinforcement Learning for Tool-Integrated Mathematical Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 当前大语言模型越来越多地受益于外部工具集成，尤其是在需要可靠计算和验证的任务上。本文针对Countdown任务，研究使用计算器工具调用以改进模型的数学推理能力。作者首先分析推理失败的原因，发现计算错误在错误响应中占据相当大比例。随后，他们构建了监督微调数据集，教模型掌握有用的工具使用模式以及如何解释计算器返回的结果。在此基础之上，进一步采用强化学习来优化工具调用策略，从而提升推理准确性。该研究展示了工具集成与强化学习结合在数学推理任务中的潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) increasingly benefit from external tool integration, especially for tasks requiring reliable computation and verification. Motivated by this, we study calculator tool calling for improving mathematical reasoning on the Countdown task. We first analyze reasoning failures and find that calculation errors account for a substantial portion of incorrect responses. We then construct supervised fine-tuning datasets to teach the model useful tool-use patterns and how to interpret returned outputs. Building on this too…
items.why_zh: 通过工具调用与强化学习显著减少计算错误，为提升LLM数学推理可靠性提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It combines tool use and RL to reduce calculation errors in LLM mathematical reasoning, improving reliability.

items.title_zh: 通过层重配置训练通信高效的专家混合语言模型
items.title_en: Training Communication-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Models with Layer Re-Configuration
items.summary_zh: 在训练专家混合（MoE）语言模型时，使用专家并行会产生大量全对全通信，可能占用端到端训练时间的很大一部分。本文提出通信高效的MoE（CE-MoE）模型，采用异构层模式，将token混合与通道混合的深度解耦。与传统模型在每个token混合层（如注意力、Mamba-2）后都插入MoE层不同，CE-MoE将专家能力集中在少数几个选定的路由MoE层中，从而减少通信开销。这种方法有望显著提升大规模MoE模型的训练效率，对于训练超大语言模型具有实用价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models with expert parallelism, all-to-all token dispatch and combine collectives can consume a substantial fraction of end-to-end training time. In this work, we study communication-efficient MoE models (CE-MoE), in which we adopt a heterogeneous layer pattern that decouples token-mixing and channel-mixing depth. Compared to conventional models which interleave MoE layers after each token-mixing layer (e.g., attention, Mamba-2), CE-MoE models concentrate expert capacity in a select few routed MoE l…
items.why_zh: 通过层重配置减少MoE训练中的通信瓶颈，提升大规模模型训练效率。
items.why_en: It addresses the communication bottleneck in MoE training via layer re-configuration, enabling faster training of large models.

items.title_zh: 当机器人听错：语音控制具身AI的安全风险图谱
items.title_en: When Robots Mishear Us: Mapping the Safety Risks of Voice-Controlled Embodied AI
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨自动语音识别（ASR）错误是否会导致具身人工智能（EAI）模型产生不安全输出。研究发现，ASR错误可能使有害指令被EAI模型接受并执行，从而降低安全性。作者模拟了ASR错误，并结合现有安全基准（SafeAgentBench和POEX）评估不同类型错误对具身AI安全的影响。结果显示，部分ASR错误保留了语义结构但增加了有害歧义，另一些则削弱了模型的拒绝行为。该研究首次系统性地描绘了语音控制具身AI面临的语音识别安全风险，对机器人和AI助手的安全性设计有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate whether automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors in user input can lead to unsafe outputs from Embodied AI (EAI) models. We find that ASR errors can lead to harmful instructions being accepted and executed by EAI models, thereby reducing safety. We simulate ASR errors and combine them with existing safety benchmarks (SafeAgentBench and POEX) to evaluate how different errors affect embodied AI safety. We find that some of them preserve semantic structure but increase harmful ambiguity, while others weaken the model refusal behaviou…
items.why_zh: 首次系统评估语音识别错误对具身AI安全性的影响，揭示了听错可能导致机器人执行有害指令的风险。
items.why_en: It systematically maps how ASR errors can compromise embodied AI safety, showing that misheard commands may lead to harmful actions.

items.title_zh: SciReC：多模态多轮关系推理的自适应交互诊断评估
items.title_en: SciReC: Diagnostic Evaluation of Multimodal, Multi-Turn Relational Reasoning with Adaptive Interaction
items.summary_zh: 关系推理需要感知理解、比较和整合概念之间的内在联系，涵盖类比、结构、因果等多种高阶认知类型。为了系统评估多模态大语言模型在这些关系推理任务上的表现，研究者提出了SciReC基准，这是一个具有模型自适应能力的多模态学术对话评测集。该基准通过动态调整交互方式，能够针对不同推理类别进行细粒度诊断，从而揭示模型在复杂关系理解上的薄弱环节。由于关系推理过程涉及多种表征形式的整合，SciReC有望为多模态模型的组合推理能力提供更全面的评估参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27461v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Relational reasoning requires the process of perceptual understanding, comparing, and integrating the underlying relationships between concepts. This ability consists of multiple categories, such as analogical, structural, and cause-effect, each capturing a different aspect of higher-order understanding. To examine the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLM) on these relational inference tasks, we developed SciReC, a model-adaptive multimodal academic dialog benchmark. As the relational reasoning process involves multiple represe…
items.why_zh: 该基准为多模态大语言模型的关系推理能力提供了系统的诊断评估方法，弥补了现有评估的不足。
items.why_en: This benchmark systematically evaluates relational reasoning in MLLMs, addressing a gap in multimodal assessment.

items.title_zh: 选择而非训练：基于LLM选择的模块化实体消歧的优势
items.title_en: Select, Don't Train: The Benefits of Modular Entity Disambiguation with LLM-Based Selection
items.summary_zh: 实体消歧是知识图谱构建和使用的关键步骤，通常被建模为单一任务，但实际上包含两个不同子问题：检索候选实体和根据上下文选择正确实体。现有的双编码器模型在共享嵌入空间中同时优化这两个目标，导致表示需要在高召回检索和精细选择之间平衡，并且依赖已训练好的检索器，当知识图谱变化时维护成本高昂。为此，近期研究提出一种模块化方法，利用大语言模型直接进行选择，从而避免训练检索器。这种“选择而非训练”的策略有望降低维护成本，提升实体消歧的适应性和效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27470v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entity Disambiguation (ED) is a key task for constructing and using knowledge graphs. State-of-the-art neural approaches commonly model ED as a single task, although it consists of two distinct subproblems: retrieving candidate entities and selecting the correct one given context. Dual-encoder models optimize for both within a shared embedding space, forcing representations to balance high-recall retrieval with fine-grained selection, and they require trained retrievers, which are costly to maintain as knowledge graphs change. While recent work…
items.why_zh: 该研究提出无需训练的模块化实体消歧方法，有望降低知识图谱维护成本并提升实体链接的灵活性。
items.why_en: This modular approach removes the need for trained retrievers, reducing maintenance costs and improving flexibility in entity disambiguation.

items.title_zh: XHotpotQA：多跳问答中的跨语言知识组合基准
items.title_en: XHotpotQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Knowledge Composition in Multi-Hop Question Answering
items.summary_zh: 知识密集型多跳问答要求系统从多个证据中选取相关信息并组合依赖事实，但现有多语言基准通常将整个示例翻译成单一语言，掩盖了推理链在语言边界处的失败。为此，研究者提出XHotpotQA，一个用于在混合语言证据上进行跨语言知识组合的受控基准。每个实例被建模为证据依赖图，问题、桥接证据、答案证据和干扰项都有明确的语言分配。该基准能够显式测试系统跨语言组合证据的能力，有助于诊断多语言问答中的薄弱环节，推动更鲁棒的多语言推理模型发展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27481v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering requires systems to select evidence and compose dependent facts, yet multilingual benchmarks usually translate an entire example into one language. This hides failures at language boundaries inside the reasoning chain. We introduce XHotpotQA, a controlled benchmark for cross-lingual knowledge composition over mixed-language evidence. Each instance is modeled as an evidence-dependency graph whose question, bridge evidence, answer-bearing evidence, and distractors have explicit language assignments…
items.why_zh: 该基准专门测试跨语言证据组合能力，填补了多语言问答在语言边界推理上的评估空白。
items.why_en: This benchmark specifically targets cross-lingual evidence composition, filling an evaluation gap in multilingual QA.

items.title_zh: 扩散语言模型的轨迹级推测解码
items.title_en: Trajectory-Level Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
items.summary_zh: 基于扩散的语言模型通过迭代去噪实现并行token生成，但现有解码策略在低置信度下会退化为逐token生成，严重限制吞吐量。与自回归模型在固定的从左到右顺序下对token序列进行推测解码不同，扩散语言模型需要对去噪轨迹进行推测，即对具有明确位置和掩码顺序的多token更新序列进行推测。为此，研究者开发了一种轨迹级推测解码框架，通过构建草稿去噪轨迹来加速生成。该方法有望显著提升扩散语言模型的解码速度和吞吐量，使其在实际应用中更具竞争力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27514v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, but existing decoding strategies collapse to single-token generation under low confidence, severely limiting throughput. Unlike autoregressive models where speculative decoding operates on token sequences in a fixed left-to-right order, dLLMs require speculating over denoising trajectories-sequences of multi-token updates with explicit positions and unmasking orders. We develop a trajectory-level speculative framework that constructs draft deno…
items.why_zh: 该工作首次将推测解码扩展到扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹层面，有望大幅提升其生成速度。
items.why_en: This work extends speculative decoding to denoising trajectories, potentially boosting diffusion LLM generation throughput.

items.title_zh: LitCurate：配置驱动的AI辅助科学数据库构建框架
items.title_en: LitCurate: A Configuration-Driven AI-Assisted Framework for Scientific Database Construction with an Application to Lower-Mantle Equation-of-State Data
items.summary_zh: 科学文献中积累了数十年的实验和计算结果，是数据驱动和基于物理建模的重要资源，但大量信息被锁定在出版物中，难以直接用于大规模分析或科学软件。从文献中构建结构化数据库尤其困难，因为需要先从大量论文中发现相关研究，再提取具有足够科学背景的数值。为此，研究者提出了LitCurate，一个配置驱动的AI辅助框架，用于自动化构建科学数据库。该框架已应用于下地幔状态方程数据的整理，展示了其在科学数据自动化提取和知识库建设中的潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27629v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The growing scientific literature contains decades of experimental and computational results that could support data-driven and physics-based modeling, yet much of this infor- mation remains locked in publications and is not readily usable for large-scale analysis or sci- entific software. Building structured databases from the literature is particularly challenging whenrelevantstudiesmustfirstbediscoveredamonglargecollectionsofpapersandreported quantities must be extracted with enough scientific context to remain usable. We present LitCurate,…
items.why_zh: 该框架有望自动化从海量科学文献中提取结构化数据，加速材料科学等领域的数据驱动研究。
items.why_en: This framework automates database construction from scientific papers, accelerating data-driven research in domains like materials science.

items.title_zh: 基于YOLO与RT-DETR的边缘端深度感知坑洞检测
items.title_en: Depth-Aware Pothole Detection Using YOLO and RT-DETR at the Edge
items.summary_zh: 坑洞检测及其严重程度测量是城市基础设施管理的重要难题，维护不及时会导致车辆损坏、交通事故和维修成本上升。现有自动化方法主要依赖二维RGB图像，无法测量坑洞的物理深度。为此，研究者提出一种深度感知的坑洞检测框架，并比较了YOLOv8n、YOLOv8nSeg、YOLOv9t、RT-DETR-L和RT-DETR-X等五种架构在RGB-D传感器融合下的检测与自动深度测量性能。该方法有望在边缘设备上实现更准确的实时坑洞检测，为道路维护提供可靠的决策依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27633v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pothole detection and its severity measurement is still an important challenges in urban infrastructure management, where late maintenance directly contributes to vehicle damage, road accidents, and escalating repair costs. Existing automated approaches depend on 2D RGB images and cannot measure physical depth of potholes. In this paper, we present a depthaware pothole detection framework and then compare five architectures: YOLOv8n, YOLOv8nSeg, YOLOv9t, RTDETRL, and RTDETRX for RGB-D sensor fusion-based detection and automated depth measuremen…
items.why_zh: 该研究将RGB-D深度信息引入坑洞检测，弥补了传统二维图像无法测量深度的不足，有助于更精准的路面维护。
items.why_en: This work integrates RGB-D depth into pothole detection, enabling physical depth measurement for more accurate road maintenance.

items.title_zh: RiskBlend：机器学习回归测试中测试输入优先级排序的多信号框架
items.title_en: RiskBlend: A Multi-Signal Framework for Test Input Prioritization in Machine Learning Regression Testing
items.summary_zh: 机器学习分类器重新训练后，之前版本正确分类的输入可能被新版本错误分类，产生回归错误。由于验证预测结果往往需要人工标注、专家审查或昂贵模拟，检测这些错误的成本很高。测试输入优先级排序旨在通过排序输入，使有限的验证预算能发现尽可能多的回归错误。现有方法通常依赖单一信号，而RiskBlend框架整合多种信号来识别高风险输入。该框架有助于提升机器学习模型迭代过程中的回归测试效率和可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27704v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When machine learning classifiers are retrained, inputs correctly classified by the previous model version may be misclassified by the updated version, creating regression faults that are costly to detect because verifying predictions against ground truth may require human annotation, expert review, or expensive simulation rather than inexpensive model inference. Test input prioritization addresses this problem by ranking inputs so that a limited verification budget reveals as many regression faults as possible. Existing approaches rely predomi…
items.why_zh: 该框架通过多信号融合提高了回归测试的效率，帮助团队在有限资源下更早发现模型退化问题。
items.why_en: This multi-signal prioritisation framework improves regression testing efficiency, enabling early detection of model degradation.

items.title_zh: 音视频大语言模型的组合失败：跨模态冲突下的后期层先验主导
items.title_en: Compositional Failure in Audio-Visual LLMs: Late-Layer Prior Dominance Under Cross-modal Conflict
items.summary_zh: 该研究将音视频冲突作为音视频大语言模型（AV-LLM）的组合泛化测试，模型需要结合同步但语义不兼容的音频和视频证据，判断两者是否匹配。实验发现，VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV在AVHBench的精确字符串Yes/No子集上，三种对齐配置均表现接近随机水平，尽管输出先验显著变化。同时，开箱即用的InternVideo2在跨模态冲突下准确率下降32.3%，指令遵循能力下降17.3%。这些结果表明，现有AV-LLM在跨模态冲突场景下存在严重的组合失效问题，可能与后期层中的先验主导有关。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27785v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study audio-visual conflict as a compositional generalization test for AV-LLMs: the model must combine synchronized but semantically incompatible audio and video evidence and decide whether the pair matches. On VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV, three alignment configurations remain nearchance on the scored exact-string Yes/No subset of AVHBench, even though their output priors shift substantially. Similarly, off-the-shelf InternVideo2 experienced a 32.3% accuracy decrease specifically under cross-modal conflict, accompanied by a 17.3% instruction-followin…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了音视频大语言模型在跨模态冲突下的脆弱性，为改进多模态组合推理提供了重要警示。
items.why_en: This work exposes critical compositional failures in AV-LLMs under cross-modal conflict, highlighting the need for better multimodal reasoning.

items.title_zh: 可操作CBFI：融合结构分解与因果反事实追溯的表格机器学习方法
items.title_en: Actionable CBFI: Integrating Structural Decomposition and Causal Counterfactual Recourse for Tabular Machine Learning
items.summary_zh: 可解释人工智能（XAI）越来越需要可操作的反事实解释，但现有方法面临因果无效性、认知负担过重和预测失败等挑战。详尽的因果搜索算法往往要求修改多个属性，而基于加性归因的SHAP等方法忽略了高阶特征协同，在XGBoost等复杂非线性模型中会导致预测优化不足和干预分散。为弥合这一差距，该研究提出可操作的CBFI方法，将结构分解与因果反事实追溯相结合。该方法旨在提供更符合因果逻辑且更易于执行的反事实解释，从而提升表格机器学习模型的可解释性和用户干预效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) increasingly calls for actionable counterfactual recourse, yet current methodologies face challenges related to causal invalidity, excessive cognitive burden, and predictive failure. Exhaustive causal search algorithms often require modifications to multiple attributes, whereas additive attribution-guided methods, such as SHAP, ignore higher-order feature synergies, leading to suboptimal predictive momentum and diffuse intervention effort in complex nonlinear models, such as XGBoost. To bridge this gap,…
items.why_zh: 该研究让反事实解释更符合因果且更具可操作性，是提升复杂表格模型可解释性与用户信任的关键一步。
items.why_en: It advances explainable AI by making counterfactual recourse more causally valid and actionable for complex tabular models.

items.title_zh: SOMTab：基于Set-Order Mamba的高效表格上下文学习
items.title_en: SOMTab: Set-Order Mamba for Efficient Tabular In-Context Learning
items.summary_zh: 基于上下文学习的表格基础模型近年来已成为针对特定任务模型拟合的有力替代方案。然而，当前性能前沿仍由注意力密集型架构主导，注意力贯穿整个建模流程。这引出一个问题：在表格上下文学习的每一阶段是否都需要注意力？为此，研究者提出SOMTab，一种基于Set-Order Mamba的高效表格上下文学习架构。SOMTab将表示构建与查询条件处理分离，从而减少对注意力机制的依赖，为表格基础模型提供了更高效的设计思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27882v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tabular foundation models based on in-context learning have recently emerged as strong alternatives to task-specific model fitting. However, the current performance frontier remains dominated by attention-heavy architectures, where attention is used throughout the modeling pipeline. This raises a natural question: is attention necessary at every stage of tabular in-context learning? We introduce SOMTab, a Set-Order Mamba architecture for efficient tabular in-context learning. SOMTab separates representation construction from query-conditioned r…
items.why_zh: 它挑战了注意力在表格上下文学习中的必要性，为降低计算成本和部署更高效的基础模型提供了新方向。
items.why_en: It questions the necessity of attention at every stage, offering a path to more efficient and scalable tabular foundation models.

items.title_zh: OpenStamp：面向开源语言模型的水印技术
items.title_en: OpenStamp: A Watermark for Open-Source Language Models
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型生成内容日益普及，水印被视为将文本归因于模型并区别于人类写作的有效方法。一类主流技术通过修改词元采样概率，在生成文本中嵌入微妙但可检测的信号。然而，这类方法不适用于开源模型，因为用户可白盒访问，在推理时轻易禁用。为此，研究者提出OpenStamp，一种专门针对开源语言模型的水印技术，旨在应对开源环境下水印易被绕过的问题，保障内容溯源与版权保护。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27899v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: With the growing prevalence of large language model (LLM) generated content, watermarking is considered a promising approach for attributing text to LLMs and distinguishing it from human-written content. A prominent class of techniques embeds subtle but detectable signals in generated text by modifying token sampling probabilities. However, such methods are unsuitable for open-source models, where users have white-box access and can easily disable watermarking during inference. In this work, we introduce OpenStamp, a watermarking technique that…
items.why_zh: 开源模型版权与水印问题日益严峻，OpenStamp为开源语言模型的内容溯源提供了可行方案。
items.why_en: It addresses the urgent need for robust content attribution in open-source LLMs, where existing watermarks can be trivially bypassed.

items.title_zh: LandingAgent：用于落地页的参考标注数据集与智能体生成框架
items.title_en: LandingAgent: A Reference-Annotated Dataset and Agentic Generation Framework for Landing Pages
items.summary_zh: 落地页是目标导向的网页界面，需要在组织信息流、视觉层次和行动号召（CTA）的同时传达特定价值主张。虽然大语言模型能根据自然语言提示生成看似合理的网页代码，但直接生成常产生通用模板和缺乏依据的说服性陈述。该研究聚焦于目标锚定、参考引导的落地页生成，要求系统通过改编真实页面中的可复用模式，为新目标创建可执行页面。为此，研究者提出LandingAgent，包含参考标注数据集与智能体生成框架，可生成更具针对性和说服力的落地页，提升LLM在自动化网页设计中的实用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.27902v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Landing pages are goal-oriented web interfaces that must communicate a target-specific value proposition while organizing information flow, visual hierarchy, and calls to action (CTA). Although large language models can generate plausible webpage code from natural-language prompts, direct generation often yields generic templates and unsupported persuasive claims. We study target-grounded, reference-guided landing-page generation, where a system must create an executable page for a new target by adapting reusable patterns from real pages withou…
items.why_zh: 它将LLM从生成通用网页代码提升到生成目标导向、有说服力的商业落地页，对自动化设计与营销具有实际价值。
items.why_en: It moves LLM-based web generation from generic templates to persuasive, goal-oriented landing pages, with clear practical value for automated design.

items.title_zh: 与什么相比？以人为锚的LLM生成基础设施即代码安全基准
items.title_en: Compared to What? A Human-Anchored Security Benchmark for LLM-Generated Infrastructure-as-Code
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地用于编写基础设施即代码（IaC），而单个不安全默认配置就可能被直接部署到生产环境。以往评估仅报告模型生成IaC的原始漏洞数量，但缺乏人类基线，无法判断模型是否真的比工程师更差。为此，研究者提出GenIaC-SecBench，一个包含100个部署场景、按架构复杂性分层、评估四个供应商共12种模型配置、生成1,196个IaC工件并由三个扫描器检测的基准。这一工作提供了人类锚定的安全比较，使LLM生成代码的安全性评估更公平、更具指导意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.28021v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to author Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), where a single insecure default can be deployed directly into production. Prior evaluations report raw vulnerability counts for model-generated IaC, but without a human baseline they cannot determine whether models are actually worse than engineers. We introduce GenIaC-SecBench, a benchmark of 100 deployment scenarios stratified by architectural complexity, evaluated across 12 model configurations from four vendors, producing 1,196 IaC artifacts scanned by three…
items.why_zh: 通过引入人类基线，它使LLM生成的基础设施代码安全评估更有意义，能帮助识别模型是否真正更易产生漏洞。
items.why_en: It establishes a human baseline for security comparisons, enabling meaningful judgments about whether LLM-generated IaC is actually riskier than human-written code.
